steps.fms: const p = [...fps.active.availableApproaches].sort((x, y) => x.ident.localeCompare(y.ident)); if (p.length) await fps.setApproach(p[0].databaseId);
const a = [...fps.active.availableArrivals].sort((x, y) => x.ident.localeCompare(y.ident)); if (a.length) await fps.setArrival(a[0].databaseId);

const p = fps.active; let i = -1; p.allLegs.forEach((e, k) => { if (k > 0 && !e.isDiscontinuity && e.definition && e.definition.waypoint && e.type === 'IF') i = k; }); if (i < 0) i = 1; p.setActiveLegIndex(i + 1);
